QC Officer 
We are looking for a Quality Inspector for our location in Waddinxveen. Do you have an eye for detail and plenty of energy? Would you like to work in an enthusiastic and informal team with a no-nonsense mentality? Then come work with us. 
 What will you do? 
As a Quality Inspector at Roveg Fruit, you work at the heart of a broad and diverse assortment of exotic fruits, vegetables, and fresh produce. Beautiful products arrive daily from all over the world and must continue their journey through our warehouse, production department, and ultimately to the customer. 
The Production Quality Inspector is an essential link between the ripening process, order picking, and the repacking department. You monitor and assess the quality of the production process and prepare quality reports. These reports cover production quality and, when necessary, stock quality. 
You inspect products according to customer specifications to ensure they meet all requirements. Using your expertise, you assess product quality so that the sales team can correctly advise customers. You support the commercial department by clearly indicating the quality level of the products, contributing to the marketability of our assortment. 
You also provide instructions to the production department to ensure that the final output (repacking, packaging, sorting, labeling) meets customer requirements. As a specialist in retail specifications, you share responsibility for the final quality check before products leave the warehouse. 
 - MBO - Dutch and English 
 Who are you? - Experience in quality control within the fresh produce (AGF) sector - Minimum MBO+ level of education and thinking - Strong communication skills - Proficiency in Dutch and/or English, spoken and written - Willingness to work in rotating shifts

The Role 
As a RF / Microwave Engineer you will bring deep signal-integrity and high-frequency design expertise into our Product Development team. You will own the microwave performance of our products from concept through validation, combining simulation, measurement and product development. 
You will work in a tight development loop where simulation, manufacturing and measurements continuously improve product performance. Experience in quantum computing is not required. 
About Delft Circuits 
Delft Circuits develops and manufactures advanced cryogenic I/O solutions that enable the next generation of quantum computing systems. Working at Delft Circuits means contributing to cutting-edge technology alongside leading quantum computing companies and research institutes worldwide. 
Your key responsibilities will include: 
RF Design & Simulation - Perform 3D EM simulations of next-generation interconnects and transitions - Design microwave filters and attenuators - Perform microwave budget and cascade analysis - Validate simulations against measurements - Shape RF architecture of next-generation products 
Technical Ownership & Collaboration - Review third-party simulation models and measurement data - Support customer projects with RF expertise - Actively collect, analyze and translate feedback from customers, partners and suppliers, inside and outside of Europe - Define product roadmaps and specifications - Contribute to product documentation - Cross-functional collaboration 
What you bring - 5-10 years of working experience of which at least 4+ years working as RF / microwave expert - Knowledge of transmission lines, S-parameters, matching, filters and attenuators - Experience with HFSS, CST or similar 3D EM tools - Experience correlating simulations with RF measurements - Collaborative mindset and good English
